reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that predicts one suggested next prompt after each completed agent turn, using a bounded auxiliary LLM call and presenting the result as ghost text in the web composer for optional draft insertion.

summaries.zh: 在每轮智能体回复完成后生成一条建议的下一条提示词，并以输入框幽灵文字形式展示，支持通过快捷键采纳到草稿。
summaries.en: Generates one suggested next prompt after each completed agent turn, displays it as ghost text in the web composer, and supports inserting it into the draft with a shortcut.

capabilities: Makes a bounded auxiliary LLM request after completed agent turns
Reads recent user and assistant turn content for suggestion generation
Writes a suggested prompt to the session log and exposes it to the web interface
Displays the suggestion as composer ghost text and can place it into the draft via a configurable shortcut
